docTitle: Mamta Singh Sengar — Salmon AEM QA Engineer
name: MAMTA SINGH SENGAR
title: ==AEM QA ENGINEER==  ·  ADOBE EXPERIENCE MANAGER TESTING

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: QA engineer with **4.8 years of experience** in functional, regression, and performance testing of web and enterprise applications. Tested content-heavy web platforms and validated functionality and performance across payment, gaming, retail, and education domains. [No direct AEM experience — see note]

sections.heading: CORE SKILLS
rows: Functional · Regression · Sanity · Smoke · Integration · UAT
Jira · Local Test Case Generator (Jira workflow)
sections.note: AEM GAP — this role requires Adobe Experience Manager experience, which your resume does not show. Fill the brackets only if you have any real AEM/CMS exposure; otherwise delete that row. If you still want to apply, your strengths are functional/regression/perf testing of content platforms — lead with those and name the gap in your cover note.

roles.title: Software Test Engineer / Senior QA
bullets: ==Validated functionality and performance== of web/mobile modules; authored 500+ test cases.
Executed regression cycles across releases, cutting release verification time from 3 days → 1 day.
Executed performance tests with JMeter for critical flows; identified bottlenecks that improved response times by 15%.

roles.title: Testing Engineer
bullets: ==Validated functionality== — executed functional, integration, system, regression, and UAT cycles.
==Validated performance== of payment and gaming portals; analysed middleware logs to reduce payment failures by 20%.
Tracked defects in Jira and improved defect resolution SLA from 72 hrs → 48 hrs.

roles.title: Career Break & Upskilling
bullets: Playwright: built automated web test suites; converted 100 manual scenarios to automated checks.
CI/CD: integrated test execution into Jenkins and GitHub Actions for PR gating and nightly regression.
Local Test Case Generator (Jira): designed a workflow to auto-generate structured test cases from Jira tickets, reducing test design time by 50%.
AI Prompting for QA: created prompts/workflows to generate test ideas and edge cases, accelerating test design by 40%.

sections.heading: PROJECTS & DOMAIN HIGHLIGHTS
bullets: Education ERP: full lifecycle testing for student, faculty, and staff modules — a content-heavy web platform.
Payment & Gaming: end-to-end testing across POS, Management, Player, and Game portals.
MS Dynamics 365 FO: tested Retail & Commerce payment connector and MPOS integrations.
